bibl.title: Genetic Criticism and the Papyri: Some Suggestions.
bibl.seg: Raffaella Cribiore, Genetic Criticism and the Papyri: Some Suggestions.
Nicola Reggiani (ed.), Greek Medical Papyri Text, Context, Hypertext = ArchPF. Beiheft 40 (Berlin - Boston, 2019) pp. 173-191, fig.
bibl.note: Genesis is a theoretical discipline that is interested in the process of writing and approaches literary texts not as finished works but as fluid products: by concentrating on what might appear as minor features of a text, it is possible to gain insight on the behavior and motivations of some ancient writers. - A papyrus of Homer with marginalia [P. Oxy. II, 223 (= MP3 733; LDAB 2026)]. - The dossier of Lollianos. - The archive of Ammon of Panopolis. - A papyrus of Favorinus: P. Vatic. Graec. Inv. 11 verso (= MP3 455; LDAB 1065). - Autograph texts on papyrus. - Two textual versions in the Anonymus Londinensis. - Conclusion.
